scenes.text: Myth or fact? SPF fifty lasts all day.
Sweat, touching your face and the sun itself wear it off. A high number doesn't change that.
scenes.head: Every sunscreen wears off.
scenes.body: Sweat, touching your face and the sun break it down.

scenes.text: Send this to whoever you're travelling with. Follow for more.
scenes.cta: Send this to your travel buddy.

caption:
SPF 50 lasts all day? Myth. ☀️
Sweat, touching your face and the sun itself wear sunscreen off, whatever the number. Outdoors, reapply every 2 hours.
Send this to whoever you're travelling with.
